name: replication_baseline_20260930
purpose: Replication baseline of the existing long/short prediction plugin. Explicit resolution of exit variant E. NOT a recovered historical run.

reading_1_plugin_params.read_by: evaluate_candidate, the retained native adapter, every launcher

reading_2_signature_default.read_by: nothing in app/ (every caller passes the parameter explicitly)

reading_3_comment_block.value_before: D ("DEFAULT - best avg profit across noise levels")

exit_variant_contradiction.why: plugin_params is the only reading any launcher consumes, so E is what every retained result (including the 241-cell sweep, manifest sha256 958726415c09ced866c7d8164dfe4e49b99b4ccb8e0e5e7059fa26effdbba94f, execution.exit_variant = E) actually executed. The signature default and the comment were dead text; they are aligned to E so that the three readings agree. Aligning them changes no retained result.
exit_variant_contradiction.what_this_is_not: It is not a recovery of a historical configuration that ran D; no such run is claimed.

take_profit_stop_loss: close-only signals compared at the bar close; market order fills at the next open; no bracket, no intrabar barrier

legacy_reproduction.note: 144 means row i + 144 rows; a retained audit measured 191-316 elapsed hours for that offset on this data

new_predictions.note: 1-6 h and 24-144 h are elapsed timestamps; origins lacking an exact target bar are excluded
